description: Summary provenance figure: cleft conservation, catalytic geometry, absence of signal peptide, and incomplete xylan pathway
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, collections
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
kd=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
def fa(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
def hyd(seq,w=19):
    v=np.array([kd.get(c,0) for c in seq]); return np.convolve(v,np.ones(w)/w,mode="valid")

fig=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(13,8.6))
fig,axes=fig

# (a) cleft vs global identity
ax=axes[0,0]
labs=["Cex\nC. fimi","XlnA\nS. lividans","Xyn10A\nC. japonicus"]
glob=[29.5,29.9,30.4]; cleft=[65.5,65.5,58.6]; ps=["p=3.1e-5","p=3.9e-5","p=9.2e-4"]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,glob,w,color="#b8c4d0",label="whole protein")
ax.bar(x+w/2,cleft,w,color="#c0392b",label="active-site cleft (29 residues)")
for i,p in enumerate(ps): ax.text(i,cleft[i]+2.5,p,ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylim(0,80)
ax.set_ylabel("identity to Q8DHP3 (%)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
ax.set_title("The Q8DHP3 cleft is conserved 2x above background\n(Fisher exact, one-sided)",fontsize=10)

# (b) catalytic carboxylate geometry
ax=axes[0,1]
names=["Q8DHP3\nAlphaFold v6","2EXO\nCex crystal","1E0V\nXlnA crystal"]
cd=[6.96,7.15,6.93]; oo=[5.37,5.62,5.23]
x=np.arange(3)
ax.bar(x-0.18,cd,0.34,color="#2c3e50",label="Glu CD - Glu CD")
ax.bar(x+0.18,oo,0.34,color="#7f9bb5",label="closest carboxyl O - O")
for i in range(3):
    ax.text(i-0.18,cd[i]+0.12,"%.2f"%cd[i],ha="center",fontsize=8)
    ax.text(i+0.18,oo[i]+0.12,"%.2f"%oo[i],ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.axhspan(4.5,5.5,color="#f0d9a0",alpha=.5)
ax.text(2.45,5.0,"retaining\nGH range",fontsize=7,ha="right",va="center")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylim(0,8.6)
ax.set_ylabel("distance (A)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False,loc="upper left")
ax.set_title("E166/E264 geometry matches crystallised\nretaining GH10 xylanases",fontsize=10)

# (c) hydropathy: no signal peptide
ax=axes[1,0]
for acc,nm,col in [("Q8DHP3","Q8DHP3 tlr1902 (cytoplasmic)","#c0392b"),
                   ("P26514","XlnA S. lividans (secreted)","#2980b9"),
                   ("P07986","Cex C. fimi (secreted)","#27ae60"),
                   ("P14768","Xyn10A C. japonicus (secreted)","#8e44ad")]:
    h=hyd(fa(acc))[:90]
    ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(h)+1),h,color=col,label=nm,lw=1.6)
ax.axhline(1.6,ls="--",color="grey",lw=1)
ax.text(62,1.72,"signal-peptide h-region threshold",fontsize=7,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("residue (N-terminal 90)"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (19-residue window)")
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,frameon=False); ax.set_title("tlr1902 lacks the N-terminal signal peptide that every\ncharacterised GH10 xylanase carries",fontsize=10)

# (d) pathway completeness
ax=axes[1,1]
steps=["endo-xylanase\nK01181","beta-xylosidase\nK01198/K15921","alpha-glucuronidase\nK01811","arabinofuranosidase\nK01209",
       "xylose isomerase\nK01805","xylulokinase\nK00854","xylose ABC uptake\nK10439/K10543"]
pres=[1,0,0,0,0,0,0]
cols=["#27ae60" if p else "#d9534f" for p in pres]
ax.barh(np.arange(len(steps)),[1]*len(steps),color=cols,height=.65)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(steps))); ax.set_yticklabels(steps,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks([]); ax.invert_yaxis()
for i,p in enumerate(pres):
    ax.text(0.5,i,"present (tlr1902 only)" if p else "absent from genome",ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title("Xylan utilisation in T. vestitus BP-1: 1 of 7 steps encoded\n(KEGG orthology, genome tel, 2524 genes)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
